titre_exercice: Section D: Essay (au choix — un sujet parmi trois)
enonce_intro_markdown: **Write an essay of between 150 – 200 words on one of the following topics.**

questions.enonce_markdown: Which do you prefer, modern or traditional medicine? Give your reasons.

rappels_de_methode.texte: An opinion essay must state a clear position early on, support it with at least two or three distinct reasons, each illustrated with a concrete example, and end with a short conclusion restating the opinion.

questions.corrige_markdown:
### Rappel de méthode
An opinion essay needs a clear structure: an introduction stating the position taken, a body with distinct, well-illustrated reasons, and a conclusion that restates the opinion without simply repeating the introduction word for word.

### Corrigé détaillé (modèle, environ 180 mots)
In my opinion, modern medicine is far more reliable than traditional medicine, although both have their place in our society.

First, modern medicine is based on scientific research and clinical trials. When I visit a hospital, doctors use precise diagnostic tools like blood tests and X-rays to identify exactly what is wrong with me, instead of relying only on guesswork.

Secondly, modern medicines are produced under strict quality control, which reduces the risk of harmful side effects. For example, vaccines developed in laboratories have successfully eliminated diseases like smallpox, something traditional herbs alone could never achieve.

However, I recognise that traditional medicine still has value, especially for minor ailments and in remote areas where hospitals are far away. Many families in my village still use traditional remedies passed down from their grandparents, and some of these treatments do work.

Nevertheless, when it comes to serious illnesses such as malaria or tuberculosis, I would always choose modern medicine, because it offers proven, tested solutions.

In conclusion, while I respect the cultural importance of traditional medicine, I prefer modern medicine for its scientific reliability and safety.

### Conseil
Always count your words roughly as you write (a paragraph of about 40-50 words) to stay within the 150–200 word limit without having to count every single word at the end.

questions.enonce_markdown: Imagine that you have just returned from a foreign country of your choice where you spent your Easter holidays. Tell your classmates how you felt while there, the things you did, what you liked and did not like, the places you visited and your general impressions.

rappels_de_methode.texte: A narrative essay recounting a trip should follow a clear chronological or thematic order, use past tenses consistently, and include specific concrete details (places, feelings, activities) rather than vague general statements.

questions.corrige_markdown:
### Rappel de méthode
A narrative essay about a personal experience should use the past tense consistently, follow a logical order (arrival, activities, likes/dislikes, departure), and include specific concrete details rather than vague statements like 'it was nice'.

### Corrigé détaillé (modèle, environ 180 mots)
Dear classmates, I have just come back from an unforgettable Easter holiday in France, and I want to share my experience with you.

When I arrived in Paris, I felt both excited and a little nervous, since it was my first time travelling abroad alone. During my two weeks there, I visited the Eiffel Tower, the Louvre Museum, and walked along the Seine River. I also tasted many new dishes, such as croissants and cheese, which I really enjoyed.

What I liked most was the efficient public transport system; the metro made it easy to move around the city quickly. I also loved meeting people from different countries and practising my French with them.

However, I did not like the cold weather, since I am used to Cameroon's warm climate, and I sometimes felt homesick, missing my family's cooking.

Overall, this trip broadened my understanding of another culture and made me appreciate my own country even more. I would recommend this experience to anyone who has the opportunity to travel.

### Conseil
Using time connectors (when I arrived, during my stay, what I liked most, however, overall) helps structure a narrative essay clearly and makes it easy for the reader to follow the chronological or thematic progression.

questions.enonce_markdown: You have discovered that many of your classmates are HIV positive. Write a speech in which you advise them on the preventive methods and cure. Your name is Esua John, and your school is GBSS Betangmbeng.

rappels_de_methode.texte: A speech must open with a form of address to the audience, state its purpose clearly, develop its main points in a logical order, and close with a call to action or a thank-you, while remaining in the correct register (persuasive but respectful).

questions.corrige_markdown:
### Rappel de méthode
A speech is written to be delivered orally: it must open with an address to the audience, clearly state its purpose, develop its points in a persuasive but respectful tone, and end with a closing remark (call to action, thanks). Facts must be accurate, especially on a sensitive topic such as HIV/AIDS.

### Corrigé détaillé (modèle, environ 180 mots)
Good morning, dear classmates. My name is Esua John, and I am a student of GBSS Betangmbeng. I stand before you today to talk about something very important: HIV and AIDS prevention.

First, let me remind you that HIV is mainly transmitted through unprotected sexual intercourse, contaminated blood, and from an infected mother to her child. To protect yourselves, I advise you to practise abstinence, which remains the only 100% effective method of prevention. If you choose to be sexually active, always use a condom correctly and consistently, and remain faithful to one uninfected partner.

I also urge everyone to go for regular HIV screening tests, as Madiba did, so that you know your status and can seek early care if needed.

Although there is currently no complete cure for HIV, antiretroviral therapy (ART) allows people living with HIV to lead long, healthy lives if they start treatment early and take their medication consistently.

Let us support one another, avoid stigma, and protect our future. Thank you for listening.

### Piège à éviter
Ne jamais affirmer qu'il existe un « remède » définitif contre le VIH/SIDA : à ce jour, seule la thérapie antirétrovirale (ART) permet de contrôler durablement la maladie, elle n'en constitue pas une guérison ; toute affirmation contraire serait factuellement incorrecte et potentiellement dangereuse pour des élèves réellement concernés.

### Conseil
Sur un sujet sensible comme le VIH, adopter un ton bienveillant et factuel (jamais moralisateur ni stigmatisant) rapporte des points tant sur la forme que sur le fond, et respecte la vocation informative réelle du discours demandé.
